description: This file sets up and runs an asynchronous pipeline for a speech processing application, involving audio input/output, speech-to-text, language model interaction, and text-to-speech components.

classes.name: LLMRunFrame
classes.description: Represents a frame for running LLM interactions within the pipeline.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Handles the sequence of processing steps for the audio and language pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline and its parameters for execution.

classes.name: PipelineParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for a pipeline task.

classes.name: LocalAudioTransportParams
classes.description: Parameters for configuring local audio transport.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Holds context for the language model interactions.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Pairs user and assistant aggregators with shared context.

classes.name: UserTurnStrategies
classes.description: Defines strategies for user turn analysis.

classes.name: TurnAnalyzerUserTurnStopStrategy
classes.description: Strategy to determine when a user turn has stopped.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main asynchronous function that sets up and runs the speech processing pipeline.
